leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize and configure the fs module to read and write files in Node.js
Apply the path module to manipulate and resolve file system paths
Construct a script that integrates fs and path modules to process file operations
Manipulate environment variables and command-line arguments using the process module
Implement error handling for file system operations using try-catch blocks
Control file streams by reading and writing data asynchronously
Update file metadata and directory structures using fs module methods
